capabilities: Draw symbols to find them by shape
Search symbols by name or command synonyms
Insert symbols at the cursor with math delimiters
Track a history of recently picked symbols
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Works fully offline; the classifier and training data ship with the plugin. Only includes symbols that Obsidian's MathJax can render.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to look up LaTeX symbols when you do not know the command name or how to type it.

relations.evidence: Draw symbols with mouse, finger, or stylus to find them by shape (inspired by Detexify).

summary: Side panel that finds LaTeX symbols by drawing their shape or searching by name, and inserts them at the cursor wrapped in math delimiters.
